selection_rationale: T-0209's sheet diverged from its own 'four reference panels' prompt into ~20 costume/figure studies spanning at least three visually distinct designs. Only the institutional-green-coat panels (consistent with the sheet's own prompt and the established player silhouette) were curated; tan/khaki and grey-armour panels elsewhere on the same sheet are a different design and were excluded, not merely deduplicated.
